page: Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is an ARM-based cloud server instance from the Epdsv6 family, operating under Microsoft Hyper-V. The server features 32 dedicated physical cores on the arm64 Microsoft Neoverse-N2 architecture operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz without hyperthreading. It provides 256 GB of memory, resulting in an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation, and includes a 128 MB L3 cache alongside 1.0 MB L2 cache per core. Local storage is directly attached via a 1,890 GB NVMe SSD. Hardware accelerated instructions include AES cryptography, while x86 vector extensions such as AVX are naturally absent given the ARM architecture.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core computational and memory access capabilities. In memory tests, the instance achieves top-tier results with read bandwidth reaching 449.0 GB/sec on uncached large blocks and 188.31 GB/sec on uncached write operations. Multi-threaded CPU execution exhibits high efficiency across stress-ng tests, multi-core Geekbench evaluations, and Passmark database operations. Redis SET operations reach 61.82 million operations per second, complemented by static web serving throughput of 56.14 GB/sec. Conversely, single-core benchmark metrics, including single-threaded stress-ng and Geekbench scores, fall within the average range across tested instance classes.

From a resource design perspective, the server balances high memory density and localized storage speed against CPU-bound single-thread constraints. The exclusion of GPU accelerators and reduced efficiency in processing large 70B parameter LLM models make it less suited for heavy deep learning tasks. However, the presence of a dedicated 1,890 GB NVMe drive alongside 256 GB of high-bandwidth memory maximizes local I/O and RAM allocation efficiency for enterprise data management. This hardware profile provides optimal conditions for running high-throughput in-memory caching platforms, enterprise relational databases, multi-threaded software compilation, and large-scale web serving infrastructures.
description: Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is an ARM-based memory-optimized virtual machine equipped with 32 dedicated Neoverse-N2 physical cores running at 3.4 GHz, 256 GB of system RAM, and a bundled 1,890 GB NVMe local SSD. Built on the arm64 architecture, this instance offers an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio supported by 128 MB of L3 cache. Benchmarks highlight exceptional memory performance, reaching up to 449.0 GB/sec in uncached large-block read bandwidth and top-tier Passmark memory scores. Multi-threaded processing demonstrates high capacity in software compilation, Redis key-value operations, and Passmark database workloads. While single-core speeds remain in the average tier and large LLM inference speeds are limited, the combination of high-speed local NVMe storage and vast memory allocation delivers effective resource density for memory-bound workloads. The instance is well suited for in-memory databases, large-scale Redis caching, relational database management systems, and high-throughput web serving environments requiring steady multi-threaded execution without dedicated GPU hardware.
